title: The Stolen Saffron Teapot
intro_text: A rare and valuable saffron teapot has gone missing from the Old Cottage Inn in Brindlebay this morning. Someone here knows more than they are saying.

locations.name: Cafe of Secrets
locations.description: A cozy corner where patrons sip strong tea and share whispered secrets in hushed tones.

locations.name: Parkside Cafe
locations.description: A quaint little cafe nestled along the town square, where the air is thick with the scent of freshly brewed coffee and gossip.

locations.name: Town Library
locations.description: A labyrinthine hall of knowledge where the shelves stretch from floor to ceiling, filled with tales of adventure and intrigue.

locations.name: Coach Yard
locations.description: An open expanse where the ground is marked by faded lines and the occasional abandoned cart, hinting at days long gone.

methods.text: Method: tricked them into a dangerous meeting place at the Town Library.
Method: loosened a beam during hours of calm at the Cafe of Secrets.
Method: sabotaged their cart so it rolled in front of them at the Coach Yard.
Method: sent them down the wrong road at the Town Library.

motives.text: Motive: keep a secret job hiding and stop it from being exposed.
Motive: punish them for a public humiliation.
Motive: end a feud that has been simmering for years.
Motive: inherit a small but useful sum.
